g.text: Canonical SOP selects the minterms whose truth-table output is one

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: Minterm numbering uses ABC with A as most significant bit. A variable is complemented when its row bit is0. Each minterm contains every input variable; the

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: canonical SOP can simplify to a much shorter equivalent expression, here F=C.
